Q: Reading from /dev/hidraw1 device connected to a Linux system A:

Most scanners can be configured as HID device or USB CDC device. Check the manual of your scanner for sth like "USB Interface Configuration" and see if it can be set to USB CDC (or USB Com Port Emulation). If it can, it will attach on linux as /dev/ttyACM* and provide data as a serial stream, which is easier to read.

Q: Powermail settings not changing in sitepackage setup? A:

I think TS should still work - did you set a dependency to ext:powermail in your sitepackage? Without that powermail might be loaded after your sitepackage and overwrite your config.

Q: Simple reading/writing from/to a USB HID device in Python? A:

I made it work with this:

    buffer= [0xFF]*33 # 33 = report size + 1 byte (report id)
    buffer[0] = 0x0 # Report ID
    buffer[1] = 0xFE
    buffer[2] = 0x00
    buffer[3] = 0xFF
    out_report.set_raw_data(buffer)
    out_report.send()
    dev.close()
